about: Callsign library for CMO Scenario Studio. Each country lists squadrons with the roles they fly and their callsign words; aircraft are named '<word> <flight><member>' (e.g. TARTAN 11, TARTAN 12...). Callsign words and squadron details are illustrative, in each air arm's style - edit, add or rename anything. 'match' lists prefixes of the database operator country (e.g. 'Russia' matches 'Russia [1992-]'). Format fields: {word} {flight} {member} {squadron}; numbers accept Python format specs, e.g. {member:02d}.
